reply.text:
It's a preference, not a requirement. Sleeves keep the joint warm and give some people a bit of confidence and a small bounce out of the hole, but they don't fix technique or replace strength. If you're moving well and nothing's bothering you, you can squat bare-kneed indefinitely.

My usual rule is to train without them for most of your sets and put them on for your heaviest work if you like how they feel. That way you're not leaning on them for everything. If the knees are giving you any trouble, that's one for a doctor or physio rather than a sleeve, and I'll happily build your squat days around whatever they clear.
